Method of Attack: Embedding .NET-based malware into Office add-ins using Microsoft Visual Studio Tools for Office (VSTO)
Executing encoded and compressed PowerShell scripts via malicious Office add-ins
Downloading password-protected ZIP archives and dropping them into local folders via remote VSTO add-ins
Achieving persistence and code execution on target machines through malicious Office add-ins
Attack Vector: Malicious Office add-ins built with VSTO embedded in documents or downloaded remotely
Payload-carrying documents containing 'custom.xml' instructions for add-in installation
ISO containers with hidden dependencies accompanying the malicious documents
User interaction to approve add-in installation prompt
